date_basis: First public paper year: original arXiv v1 date when available; historical Tesseract uses its verified 2007 paper year, without inventing a day. Checkpoint release dates and later venue years are separate.
availability_checked: Per-entry verification on 2026-11-09 or 2026-11-10; see checked and sources fields.
availability_definition: Yellow marks a verified authors-released trained checkpoint, including an official adapter or a released subset of model components. Public weights do not imply unrestricted use, fully released training data, or an open-source license. Plain labels denote a method/framework or no official checkpoint verified, not proof that weights cannot exist.
chronology_note: Complete 62-work selection through 10 November 2026. The main figure is a selective 32-work overview, while the companion atlas retains all 62 records. Small color marks indicate overlapping, coexisting research directions, not scientific ancestry, replacement or performance superiority. Year clusters are schematically spaced, not on a linear time scale.

entries.name: Tesseract
entries.date_basis: Publication year of Ray Smith, An Overview of the Tesseract OCR Engine, ICDAR2007, pp629-633; not engine invention or open-source-release date.
entries.availability_note: No matching2007paper trained-model release verified. Do not fabricate a day or substitute modern Tesseract5 traineddata for the historical engine.

entries.name: CRNN
entries.availability_note: Official author implementation links the trained crnn_demo_model.t7; this is scene-text recognition, included as an enabling OCR precursor.
